Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The draft of the return is provided to the board president and treasurer for review prior to filing. The board president and treasurer review the tax return for any errors or omissions. When the process is complete, the tax return is signed and then filed with the Internal Revenue Service.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A conflict of interest policy is reviewed by the Board of Trustees annually. Board trustees annually sign the conflict of interest statement. Officers and key employees sign and return the acknowledgment page of their employee handbook, which contains the conflict of interest policy.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Compensation of the school's officers and key employees is reviewed by the Board Compensation Committee. The annual compensation increase is determined by a formula using comparable compensation for similar positions.
